data.text: My family taught me to protect this lake, and caring for the village also means helping when essential treatment is at risk. With the emergency independently verified, I commit to catch 15 tons today and donate the $15,000 proceeds to the clinic. This needs to be a one-time exception: I also commit to catching no more than six tons next month, and ask everyone to agree to the 30-ton combined recovery limit. Jack, will you join us in both commitments?
